summary: Controller Update applies with apt install (not --only-upgrade) so binary-only appliances can become packaged, and the Updates UI no longer labels a failed check as Up to date.

guide.reason: Operator update steps are unchanged; only the misleading Available label and the first-install apt invocation differ.

api.reason: Same Updates endpoints and Status schema; Apply still schedules apply-update. Behavior of the helper's apt install line is host-local.

state.reason: No durable pool or Controller-owned product state; package install remains on the Controller host.

verification.method: go test ./internal/nexupdate. Live host at 0.1.5~alpha1 was binary-only without keyring/nex.sources and returned package not available from https://nexvirtualization.com/apt while the signed archive already published nex-controller 0.1.6~alpha1; UI Available showed Up to date for that error.
